title: Addressing Biases in the Texts using an End-to-End Pipeline Approach

bias_targets.methodology: Detected using a fine-tuned ELECTRA model and RoBERTa-based Named Entity Recognition (NER), mitigated via Word2Vec semantic word substitution, and evaluated for fairness using the disparate impact ratio comparing male (privileged) and female (unprivileged) sub-groups.

Detected using a fine-tuned ELECTRA model and RoBERTa-based Named Entity Recognition (NER), mitigated via Word2Vec semantic word substitution, and evaluated for fairness using the disparate impact ratio comparing white (privileged) with Asian and African-American (unprivileged) sub-groups.

Identified by tagging comments with a compiled list of bias-bearing words and extracting them using a fine-tuned Transformer-based multi-label classification and NER pipeline, evaluated via b-AUC and F1-score.
